subject: MLCo-op — booth follow-up: inference priorities & pilot
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Tamara Singh <tamara@mlcoop.com>, Alex Jones <alex.jones@mlcoop.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MLCo-op — booth follow-up: inference priorities & pilot

Hi Tamara / Alex —

Great to meet you at the ML Co-op Day booth yesterday — thanks for the candid chat about the tricky latency patterns you see on long-form extraction workflows. I wanted to recap the things we discussed and propose a short next step so we can move quickly if this looks like a fit.

Recap from the booth:
- You prioritize p95 latency <= 300ms for short queries and predictable per-token cost for long extraction runs (~2–5k tokens).
- Team is interested in a short pilot to validate cost and tail latency on your uploader + extract pipeline.
- Security: you mentioned SOC 2 and VPC/private tenancy as procurement blockers.

Suggested next steps:
1) 30-minute call this week to scope a pilot (what data subset, success metrics: p95, cost per 1k tokens, error rate).
2) We’ll send a 1‑pager and SOC2 summary up front.
3) If agreed, a 2‑week pilot on Redwood Dedicated with a fixed trial cap and a simple mutual action plan.

Availability: I have open slots Tue/Wed 10:00–12:00 PT and Thu 14:00–16:00 PT. If none of those work, feel free to ping a time that does or use our quick scheduler: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min

Attaching a one‑pager with quick feature highlights and pilot checklist.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_inference_one-pager.pdf (1 page PDF)

Hi Stephanie —

Apologies for the delay — it’s been hectic getting synthesis ready for next week. We are interested in a pilot to validate cost and tail latency. A couple of quick asks before we schedule: 

- Can you send a ballpark pricing range for a 2‑week dedicated pilot (single GPU pool, expected throughput 50 qps peak, estimated 100k tokens/day)?
- Please attach a brief SOC 2 summary and any details on data residency/VPC options.
- If okay, loop in an engineering contact so we can exchange basic sample payloads and I/O formats.

If you can get that over by EOD Friday we’ll try to book a time for early next week.

Thanks —
Tamara Singh
Head of ML Infrastructure | ML Co‑op
